mines.mine_notes: Open pit heap leach mine, Zacatecas. 2025: 8,938,173 t stacked @ 0.54 g/t Au; produced 96,764 oz; sold 98,043 oz; cash cost $778/oz; AISC $865/oz. Reserves as at Dec 31, 2025 ($1,700/oz Au, $22/oz Ag).
mines.processing: Two-stage crushing and heap leach with Merrill-Crowe

mines.mine_notes: Acquired Feb 28, 2025 from Newmont (first full year under Orla). Underground mine, Northwestern Ontario. Reserves as at Dec 31, 2025 ($1,700/oz Au).
mines.processing: Conventional crushing, grinding, gravity and CIP
